projects.name: Sharjah Sports City - Sharjah Central Route
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a sports city in the Central Region of Sharjah. The project will cater to both team and individual sports, will feature four sports complexes and has been designed to host local, regional, and international events.

The design includes a central square, where four major roads converge from different directions: Al Madam, Al Badayer, Mahafiz and Al Bataeh, and Sharjah Sports City. At the heart of this square will stand the 'Sports City Stadium,' which will serve as the central feature of phase one of the project.

The stadium is envisioned as an architectural landmark, symbolizing a bird soaring over sand dunes. Its structure is composed of two main elements—the platform and grandstand, shaped to resemble the undulating dunes of the surrounding desert. The roof of the stadium, shaped like a bird with outstretched wings, changes color with the time of day, reflecting a silver hue in the morning and transitioning to a golden-red glow in the evening.

Sports City will feature advanced amenities, including an air-conditioned seating system with integrated cooling pipes. The stadium's design also prioritizes environmental sustainability, harmonizing with the natural landscape and reflecting the agility, speed, and strength of an athlete.

Sharjah Sports City - Sharjah Central Route is a greenfield mega urban development project in Sharjah, valued at USD 2000.0 million, at design. Developed by Government Of Sharjah - Directorate Of Public Works. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a Six Senses Residences consisting of a 122-story tower with 251 apartment units including 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom options, along with penthouses and sky mansions, aiming for LEED Silver certification. Incorporating Sleep With Six Senses bedroom amenities and principles of biophilia and classical feng shui, these residences offer bespoke features such as wellness wardrobes stocked with fitness and biohacking equipment, as well as mood-boosting sensory art.

Once complete, the Project will be the tallest tower in the world. Amenities in the project include swimming pools on levels 4 and 99, a sky lounge, a business center, men's and women's health clubs, a cigar lounge, a banquet hall, a theatre, an observation deck, and 26 high-speed elevators.

Complementing the infrastructure are extensive amenities occupying 61,250 square feet across four levels, each uniquely themed to enhance well-being. Plans include a longevity center merging cutting-edge science with personalized services, alongside facilities such as a gym, cryotherapy chambers, a crystal sound healing room, and a spa area with hydrotherapy amenities and a juice bar. Additionally, the Skydeck on the 109th floor features a 25-meter lap pool, adding to the innovative design.

Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Dubai, valued at USD 1200.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Six Senses Resorts & S. P. A,Select Group. Lead consultant Wsp Middle East (Dubai),Wsp Middle East (Dubai),Woods Bagot (Dubai); MEP consultant Specialised Engineering Consultants (Spec). Main contractor Arabian Construction Company (Acc) (Dubai); MEP contractor Innovo Build Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: P 17 Tower - Sheikh Zayed Road
projects.description: The project involves the construction of Nebula Tower, a 90-storey mixed-use supertall skyscraper strategically located on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai, within walking distance of the Emirates Towers Metro and adjacent to the DIFC. The tower will rise approximately 351 metres and deliver nearly 88,000 square metres of net lettable Grade-A office space, alongside a luxury boutique hotel and branded residences. The development will offer best-in-class commercial office environments with a strong emphasis on sustainability, targeting high environmental performance standards such as LEED or Estidama. Located on one of the last undeveloped double plots in the area, the project’s prime positioning offers exceptional connectivity to Dubai’s central business district and transport network, enhancing convenience for tenants and visitors. This combination of premium office, hospitality, and residential components positions Nebula Tower as a landmark destination and a key addition to Dubai’s skyline. P 17 Tower - Sheikh Zayed Road is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 225.8 million, at tender. Developed by Aldar Properties Pjsc. Lead consultant Atkinsrealis,Atkinsrealis; MEP consultant Atkinsrealis. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: MAG 777 - Dubai Sports City (DSC)
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 22-storey residential tower in Dubai Sports City. The project will feature approximately 261 units, including a mix of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. Facilities in the project include 24 hours security, four high speed elevators, mood lighting and covered parking.

Amenities in the project includes a golf course, garden and canal views, covered parking on the ground floor, valet parking services, a swimming pool, a gymnasium for men and women, a rooftop health club, outdoor terrace, a concierge desk, a children's play area and a nursery, a separate spa, marble lobby, a party hall as well as wi-fi technology.

projects.name: Tiger Sky Tower - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 122-story residential tower in Business Bay. Soaring an impressive height of 532 meters, this building is set to break height records. The project will also house the world’s highest penthouse at 427 meters. The architectural renderings of Dubai’s Tiger Sky Tower are stunning, showcasing rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows that offer views of the nearby Burj Khalifa.

The project offers 849 fully furnished luxury residential units, comprising 208 1-bedroom, 414 2-bedroom, 158 3-bedroom, and 50 4-bedroom apartments, catering to various preferences with spacious layouts and high-end finishes for modern living comfort.

Positioned as the world’s tallest residential building next to the Burj Khalifa, the Tiger Sky Tower features impressive amenities. These include a basketball court surrounded by lush greenery and a lounge area adorned with palm trees. Additionally, the building will host the world’s highest adventure park, infinity pool, and restaurant.

Other facilities include a cigar lounge, a kids’ play area, a gym, shops, and a spa. Notably, the Tiger Sky Tower will also feature the tallest rainforest within a residential building in the world.

projects.name: Dubai Square Mall - Dubai Creek Harbor
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the largest malls in the world namely, Dubai Square. The project will spread over an area of 2.6-million square meters and is set to be the iconic retail, hospitality and residential district for the future.

The project will be a technology-driven retail destination in Dubai Creek Harbor. The mall will offer extensive retail choices, unique dining concepts, and world-class leisure attractions. The technological innovation offer ‘omnichannel retailing’. It enables the consumer to shop predominantly via mobiles or at a retail store. It not only drives in-store retail but also the online engagement of brands with customers. With its location in Dubai Creek Harbour, and by serving as the closest

Dubai square will have 750,000 square meters of gross floor retail space, which is nearly more than twice the gross leasable area of The Dubai Mall. The project will offer around 1,500 hotel rooms and over 1,000 apartment units.

It is spread across three levels, each presenting a unique set of experiences to the customer. The mall will include dedicated streets, plazas, and a glass roof, skylights and shopfront windows which will give it an impression of an indoor city. It will have industrial themed sections as well as traditional Arabic architecture in other parts. Along with that, a Chinese city named Chinatown is planned for the development. Parks, patches of green and lush landscaping will provide a natural balance to state-of-the-art facilities. Special LED technology is set to drive impactful and interactive backdrops and delight customers throughout their journey. The shopping center will act as a key feature of the Dubai Creek Harbor development. It will also feature an Art District.

The ground floor will have an event arena like celebrity performances, concerts and theatre shows in a futuristic entertainment arena with 3D projection mapping, theatrical sound and lighting and a broad spectrum of event spaces on streets and alleys.

The first floor has a magnificent four-lane boulevard lined with luxury retail, dining and leisure outlets. Dubai Square will offer special VIP dressing rooms, smart fitting rooms with interactive mirrors, curated private fashion collections, personalized AI recommendations, 3D printed clothing and accessories, fashion museums and more.

The second floor will have an activities arena, 'Ice Adventure', as well as a cutting-edge Cineplex, a waterpark, sports arena, supermarket and the metro link.

Dubai Square will be linked directly to the Dubai Creek Tower through a cutting-edge underground extension. It will open at a plaza at the base of the Tower. The Plaza is a clock-shaped haven of landscaping, palm trees and water features sprawling across half a kilometer of land.

The F&B section is one of the unique attraction to the visitors. Specially designed apps will be developed for ordering food and beverage. They provide personalized dining recommendations and 3D-printed food delicacies. Dubai Square will also have live cooking stations, street vendors, festive pop-up markets, grab-and-go F&B offerings and an organic market.

It will have a free metro-link from the airport will transport. This will help the mall to attract around five or six million transiting passengers through Dubai International Airport. It will have a dedicated metro hub namely, Grand Central Station located within the retail complex.

Dubai Square Mall - Dubai Creek Harbor is a greenfield shopping mall project in Dubai, valued at USD 2700.0 million, at under construction (3.0 percent complete). Developed by Emaar Properties Pjsc,Dubai Holding. Lead consultant Dp Architects Pte Ltd. (Dubai),Santiago Calatrava Sa,Arcadis Middle East (Dubai),Brewer Smith & Brewer Gulf (Bsbg); MEP consultant Holford Associates. Main contractor Dutco Balfour Beatty (Dutco Construction Co.   • A trauma centre and specialized medical units
  • A state-of-the-art radiology suite and medical laboratory
  • Dedicated ICU, NICU, and PICU beds

Spanning over 42,000 sqm, the expansion will add more than 160 new beds, increasing the hospital’s total capacity to nearly 200 beds.

projects.name: The Island - Umm Suqeim 2
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a beachfront development spread over 3.5 million square meters for touristic and leisure services.

It will include Las Vegas hotel brands such as, MGM, Bellagio and Aria containing 1,000 hotel rooms and apartments, 10 villas with a built-up area of 105,218 square meters as well as luxurious restaurants and cafés and a theatre.

The island will also include indoor and outdoor swimming pools, business person lounge, water fountains and artificial waterfalls. 'Dubai Spher', which is an entertainment tower situated in the middle of the island, it rises to a distance of 110 meters and can accommodate about 300 seats for guests to enable them to see the sound and light displays in 3D with special effects.

The theatre will have a seating capacity of 800 and occupy an area of 80,000 square feet. It will host shows organized by MGM, conferences, festivals and weddings.

The beach club at the island will offer a number of maritime leisure services and activities to guests and visitors. Water shows will be organized in the evenings, and the club and its five-star facilities are also capable of hosting special honouring ceremonies.

The island will be surrounded by a corniche spanning an area of 1.2km that will include cafés, restaurants and retail stores. The ‘Cave of Wonders’, occupying 124,000 square feet of space, will focus on providing entertainment for children and their families through sports and games that cater to different age groups.

The project will comprise laboratories for food, energy and water as well as agricultural testing and studies about food security in the future. The laboratories will stimulate the red planet's terrain and the harsh environment through 3D printing technology, heat and radiation insulation. projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the resort and residences comprising a basement level, a parking level, a ground floor, 12 additional floors and a roof in Al Heerah Beach. The project includes a total of 238 rooms. The residential project will encompass 128 meticulously crafted one- to four-bedroom units.
